description.value: You channel the occult secrets of the Darksea to conjure its corrupting waters. When you take this feat, you choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.oUDNCArkQTdhllxD]{Aqueous Orb}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZIk1EYbG6l4JuUkO]{Coral Scourge}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.eIPIZp2FUbFcLNdj]{Pillar of Water}. You can cast your chosen spell once per day as an innate occult 3rd rank spell. The water or coral you conjure through these spells have a dark haze about them and the effects count as coming from an Aberration. Creatures other than yourself or those you designate when you cast the spell suffer from a myriad of frightening whispers and haunting aberrant sightings if they are under the spell’s effects at the start of the turn or when they enter the spell’s area, taking @Damage[2d6[mental]] with a @Check[will|traits:mental] basic Will save against your spell DC or the spell DC used by the spell.
